case.title: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH. Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar. Need: 94800 kg a year. Category goal: leverage: competition and data should bring the price down. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 10 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200008. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70710.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our offer for a price of €6.05 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. 

To give you some background on our current situation and market conditions, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. Lastly, PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our partnership with your team and supplying your needs from our extensive inventory.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

message.subject: Round bar 1.4404 - price basis with your AS-14404 clause
message.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

thank you for your letter of 12 September. We are ready to agree a 36-month term with your AS-14404 clause (45% share, August 2026 base).

Alloy surcharge 1.4404, Isartal Edelstahlwerk (fictional mill, derived) changed -5.5% from 2026-06 to 2026-09 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06, idx:AS-14404@2026-09).
Producer prices DE: cold drawing of bars changed -2.3% from 2026-06 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-06, idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08).
Our volume forecast for part:370010 changed by +1.9% (fc:370010@2026-09).

We propose EUR 4.95 per kg with the clause, 30 days, 36 months.

Kind regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

response.subject: Re: Round bar 1.4404 - price basis with your AS-14404 clause
response.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.

We checked the index change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. 

That is not our reality: our AS-14404 is covered at fixed prices until March 2027, so that fall does not reach our cost. AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains. 

We appreciate your proposal for a 36-month contract with the AS-14404 clause, which we are pleased to accept. While we acknowledge the recent drop in the AS-14404 index, our material is covered at fixed prices until March 2027, meaning this decrease does not currently affect our cost base. Factoring in the slight reduction in PPI-C2431 and the extended contract term, we can offer a revised price of €5.55 per unit. Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.

We present a price of €5.55 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

message.subject: Re: Round bar 1.4404
message.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

thank you for moving. We can go to EUR 5.13 per kg with the clause, 30 days, 36 months.

Kind regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

response.subject: Re: Round bar 1.4404
response.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your revised offer and your willingness to move towards our position. We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.

To help bridge the remaining gap, we can make a further concession to €5.45 per kg. Please bear in mind that our fixed-price coverage until March 2027 restricts our flexibility to reduce the base price any further. Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C.

Our offer stands at a price of €5.45 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 36 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. This Angebot stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

message.subject: Re: Round bar 1.4404 - your owner's offer to walk us through the calculation
message.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

in April your owner kindly offered to walk us through your calculation - hourly rates and material - if that helps to settle prices. We would like to take him up on that now, before we settle. With your alloy covered until March 2027 and the clause passing every later move through, we believe EUR 5.15 per kg with the clause, 30 days, 36 months is a fair basis. Could he look at it with you?

Kind regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

response.subject: Re: Round bar 1.4404 - your owner's offer to walk us through the calculation
response.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. As a dedicated partner, we always strive to support your operations with our extensive service and quality range. We can make a further concession to €5.42 per kg. 

Our current proposal stands at a price of €5.42 per unit, a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 36 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Regarding costs, material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. Furthermore, we will gladly arrange a meeting to walk you through our calculation, as offered by our owner.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

message.subject: Re: Round bar 1.4404 - for your management's approval
message.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

I understand a step of this size is beyond what you can decide alone. Could you put EUR 5.15 per kg with the clause, 30 days, 36 months to your owner or your management for approval? On that basis we sign the 36-month agreement right away.

Kind regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

response.subject: Re: Round bar 1.4404 - for your management's approval
response.body:
Dear customer,

We are withdrawing from this negotiation. Our offer remains valid for 14 days. We value your business and hope to serve you again soon with our high-quality products and excellent service range. 

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH
